correctness.rationale: Exact four-vertex determinant polynomial coefficients in Z[phi] and 260072 certified Bernstein signs establish |D|<=Q for every real t in [0,1/2]; polynomial witness (0,13,16,53) attains Q. Separate affinity extends to every contained tetrahedron. Strict positivity of Bernstein basis on the open interval freezes exact equality sets. An independent 487635-quadruple exact check gives 120 vertex maxima; their common-triple graph is a perfect matching with exactly 60 corresponding same-original-edge pairs, and the multilinear equality support argument proves all movable tetrahedra. Endpoint maximizers are not classified. verify.py was rerun successfully with no external dependencies.

originality.rationale: All seven focused truncated-icosahedron and icosidodecahedron published-finding corpus searches returned no matching continuous cubically parameterized sharp tetrahedron profile or full sixty-segment equality classification. Full primary text of the two closest exact geometry results and relevant foundational 2014 papers was materially compared by statements and implications rather than by titles. Known endpoint maxima and broad simplex/determinant methods do not imply the stated polynomial and classification. Historical priority risk remains.
residual_risks: Earlier encyclopedic and regular-polyhedron tables were not exhaustively searched; especially Gritzmann–Klee–Larman (1995) is historically relevant general literature whose full text was not inspected.
An unindexed special calculation of the truncated-icosahedron maximum may exist; absence from semantic search alone is not a uniqueness guarantee.
Independent expert priority comparison and verification have not been undertaken.

value.rationale: The one-parameter uniform edge-truncation of the iconic regular icosahedron naturally interpolates the regular icosahedron, soccer-ball truncated icosahedron, and icosidodecahedron. The exact polynomial globally optimizes any contained tetrahedron for an entire real continuum and gives a nontrivial complete and stable 60-segment equality geometry plus an exact new soccer-ball benchmark. This addresses meaningful missing shape-continuity structure beyond endpoints, not a generic exercise, renaming, or unmotivated narrow invariant.
